Gemma 4 forces the TRITON_ATTN backend on this build. FA4 does not support its heterogeneous head dimensions (256 local, 512 global), so these are Triton attention numbers, not FlashAttention.

vLLM rejects every tool-calling request with a 400 unless --enable-auto-tool-choice and --tool-call-parser are set, so a server started without them scores 0 on eval-tools for a configuration reason rather than a model one. This cell sets --tool-call-parser gemma4, verified against a live tool call before the run.

provenance.notes: NVIDIA DGX Spark (ASUS Ascent GX10, GB10) on Ubuntu 24.04 / DGX OS, driver 580.173.02, CUDA 13.0, headless apart from an idle desktop session. vLLM 0.27.1 from the stock vllm/vllm-openai:v0.27.1-aarch64 image, with transformers pinned to 5.8.1 at container start: the image ships transformers 5.15.0, whose per-layer heterogeneous-config guard makes vLLM 0.27.1 fail to read the Gemma 4 head_dim (AmbiguousGlobalPerLayerAttributeError) before the engine starts. vLLM reports that Gemma 4 has heterogeneous head dimensions (head_dim 256 local, 512 global) and forces the TRITON_ATTN backend because FA4 does not support them. GPU KV cache 9,493,769 tokens. Thinking is OFF here: the stock Gemma 4 chat template defaults enable_thinking=false, unlike the LM Studio cell on apple-m2-max-32gb where the LM Studio model.yaml turns it on, so output token counts and the reasoning-sensitive eval scores are not comparable between the two cells on that axis. The DeepSeek-v4-Flash service normally resident on this machine was stopped for the duration of the run.
